broadway-week-fall-2026.detail: entirely abstract and flat — no building, no facade, no marquee board, no perspective and no floor. Every element is a separate sheet of matte paper lying almost flat against the ground with a soft shadow under its edge: the tickets are plain unmarked rectangles fanned like a dealt hand, the bulbs are evenly spaced circles in three straight rows, the curtains are simple vertical paper strips with folded edges.
